summary: Kittitas County, Wenatchee NF: a 1929 platform, a 1933 steel tower and a 1938 L-4 at the true summit, removed in 1967; drive-up today, with communications towers.

facts.design: Platform tower and tent camp (1929); steel tower (1933); 40 ft pole L-4 tower at the true summit (1938)
facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1967. The summit now has communications towers, and the 1933 footings are nearly gone.

access.note: Forest Service roads reach the summit. Willhite says most vehicles can reach the top; the last 3 miles of gravel have potholes.

visit.trail_note: Drive-up or under one mile to the summit, by Forest Service roads from Ellensburg (exit 109) or Cle Elum. No lookout tower stands to climb.

events.note: First lookout: a platform tower and tent camp
Steel tower with a 6 by 6 ft cab; the register and FireLookout.com say 45 ft, Willhite and a 1937 newspaper say 40 ft
William Hutchins at the lookout; the Wenatchee Daily World reported eight summers at the station
40 ft pole L-4 tower built at the true summit to the east; garage and woodshed plans approved in May 1938
40 ft pole L-4 removed; FireLookout.com says destroyed
Forest Service put out a 20 by 20 ft fire at the old lookout (Ellensburg Daily Record)
Registered August 15, 2012 as US 1378, WA 278; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief says FireLookout.com lists the site but not on its map of standing lookouts. Its page is headed R.I.P. 1938-1967 and says destroyed in 1967, so it treats the site as gone, which agrees with the register.
The 1933 steel tower is 45 ft in the register and FireLookout.com, and 40 ft in Willhite and the 1937 newspaper. The story gives no height for the 1933 tower.
The register and Willhite say the L-4 was removed in 1967; FireLookout.com says destroyed that year. The story says removed and notes FireLookout's wording.

notes_for_editor: Do not confuse this with the Quartz Mountain in Ferry County on the Colville National Forest, which the search returned; that is a different lookout and is not used. Elevation disagrees across sources: the register gives 6,390 ft (1,948 m), Willhite gives 6,300 ft, and a 1937 article quoted on Forest Lookouts gives 6,220 ft; the story does not give one. The public access rating rests on Willhite's undated guide, not a Forest Service notice; check Wenatchee NF road and campground status before a visit. Photo captions on the Willhite page are undated. No new photos were added. Used 1 WebSearch and 6 page reads.
